rv.q: The inventive physical acting of all five is breathtaking.
The clever staging and inventive use of props turn the challenge of recreating Middle-earth with a small cast into a great source of comedy.
Ultimately, Fly, You Fools! captures the essence of The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring through clever stagecraft and some genuinely ingenious theatrical tricks.
One does not simply sit and watch Fly, You Fools; instead, it is impossible not to be swept up within the chaos, comedy, and craft of this impressively charming piece of theatre.
Together they all have an infectious energy that sweeps the audience along on this epic adventure.
‘Fly, You Fools!’ is a clever, entertaining and brilliantly orchestrated shoestring parody that could be even stronger with a little more chaos.

cn.t: Critics largely rave about this Lord of the Rings parody, praising its inventive physical comedy and soundscape. One outlier finds it less convincing, but most agree it's a brilliantly funny, ingeniously staged hour of chaos.
